caption:
day 1 of my 100 days, i posted: be who you were meant to be, not told to be.

i didn't know there was research behind it.

what are you putting off? 👇

slides.text:
what do people regret most
at the end of their lives?

slides.query: most common regrets of the dying
slides.result: A palliative care nurse wrote that the most common regret was: **"I wish I'd had the courage to live a life true to myself,** not the life others expected of me."
slides.source: Bronnie Ware, The Top Five Regrets of the Dying (2012)
slides.image: window snowy forest dark room waiting

slides.query: do people regret action or inaction more
slides.result: Over the long run, people regret **the things they didn't do** more than the things they did.

slides.text:
not the risk
the never trying
